name: air-rendering-contract-depth
vertex: void main() { sampleUV = a_position.xy * 0.5 + 0.5; gl_Position = cc_matViewProj * cc_matWorld * vec4(a_position, 1.0); }
fragment: void main() { float d = texture(sceneDepth, sampleUV).r; float viewDistance = depthParams.x * depthParams.y / (depthParams.y - d * (depthParams.y - depthParams.x)); cc_FragColor = vec4(viewDistance / 10.0, sceneDepthVisibility(sampleUV, depthParams.z, depthParams.w), d, 1.0); }
